RATIFIED hardware: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Knob-Touch-LCD-1.8 (S3). UX living doc: spinme/HILEVEL.md (NOT locked -- expect edits; WorkItems are preliminary and will be re-groomed when HILEVEL locks).

Strategy: ratchet -- small vertical slices, lock learnings with tests/docs, then next level. Avoid big-bang.

Parallel subtodos (user-authorized):
1) Device UI platform: WiFi, display, rotary, touch on Waveshare (firmware-facing).
2) Audio control plane: Sonos S1 + Volumio zone drivers as a **desktop Python library** + throwaway Flask UI; port to on-device later. Integration of ported drivers + UI stays on this parent (4a26).

Parent owns: HILEVEL churn bookkeeping, merge of both children, final ESP32 integration MVP.

LongSummary.raw: spinme Waveshare music controller splits into two parallel tracks while HILEVEL.md stays unlocked. Device track builds WiFi/display/encoder/touch on the S3. Audio track builds Sonos S1 and Volumio zone control as a desktop Python library exercised by a throwaway Flask app, then ports onto the device. Parent 4a26 merges both and does final on-device integration. WorkItems are preliminary ratchets: small slices, tests for learnings, then the next layer.
